sections.content: You know comparisons with *más*, *menos*, *tan* and *que* / *como* from A2 Unit 6. Here you use them to compare ideas of success: El éxito es más importante que el dinero; una vida tranquila es tan valiosa como un salario alto.

items.spanish: Para mí, el éxito es más importante que el dinero.
items.english: For me, success is more important than money.

items.spanish: Una vida tranquila puede ser tan valiosa como un salario alto.
items.english: A quiet life can be as valuable as a high salary.

items.spanish: No todos valoran el éxito de la misma manera.
items.english: Not everyone values success in the same way.

sections.content: Use *de la misma manera* to say that people value something in the same way; with *no todos* it says they value it differently.
